segments.he: מוּתָּר לְהַקְרִיב לַבְּאֵר וְכוּ׳. תְּנַן הָתָם: לֹא יַעֲמוֹד אָדָם בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים וְיִשְׁתֶּה בִּרְשׁוּת הַיָּחִיד, בִּרְשׁוּת הַיָּחִיד וְיִשְׁתֶּה בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן מַכְנִיס רֹאשׁוֹ וְרוּבּוֹ לִמְקוֹם שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹתֶה.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «It is permitted to bring» the upright boards «closer to the well,» provided that the enclosed area is large enough for a cow to stand in and drink, with its head and most of its body inside the partitioned space. Similarly, «we learned there» in a mishna: «A person may not stand in a public domain and drink in the private domain,» and likewise he may not stand «in the private domain and drink in a public domain, unless he brings his head and most of his» body «into the place where he is drinking.»

moves.summary: lemma: the posts may be brought close to the well
parallel mishna: head and most of the body must enter the drinking domain

positions.claim: one may not drink across domains unless head and most of the body enter where he drinks
